lines: Ay Yüzlüm: Im looking for the guy i love is he here????
Uqi: Depends on how much love is it
intro.title: Moonlight Courier
intro.subtitle: A message has to travel 9,571 km from Istanbul to Bandung tonight. Only you can deliver it.
intro.howTo: Hold (or press space) to fly up · let go to float down · collect the stars · avoid the clouds

checkpoints.title: The first message
checkpoints.quote: Im looking for the guy i love is he here????
checkpoints.text: And somehow the guy you were looking for was right here. One year later, he still is.

checkpoints.question: How many messages did we send each other this year?
checkpoints.reveal: 53,096 messages. And at least 4,783 photos, stickers and voice notes on top of that.

checkpoints.title: Ay Yüzlüm
checkpoints.quote: smth like 'pretty like the moon' and the translation is 'my moon-faced one'
checkpoints.text: That's why this whole thing happens under the moon. It's your name in my phone, and it's the one thing we can both look at, at the same time.

checkpoints.question: Guess the song 🎧
checkpoints.hint: One of the songs we sent each other.
checkpoints.reveal: Placeholder – write why this song reminds you of her.

checkpoints.title: Our first month
checkpoints.quote: Oh now its our first month together btww
checkpoints.text: I said "You mean three months". You said "6 actually". Neither of us was counting right, because it already felt longer.

checkpoints.question: How many times did I call you "salak"?
checkpoints.hint: Be honest. You deserved most of them.
checkpoints.reveal: 310 times. But you called me salak 217 times, so we're both guilty 😌

checkpoints.title: My birthday
checkpoints.quote: connection is not about proximity, but about hearts choosing each other again and again.
checkpoints.text: You wrote me a whole letter from Türkiye. I still read it.

checkpoints.question: Your longest "I love you sooooo…" message. How many o's?
checkpoints.hint: 22 September 2026, 07:57. You really held that key.
checkpoints.reveal: 7,201 o's. I tried to answer with "so so so so…" but you still won.

checkpoints.title: Uno nights
checkpoints.quote: But you are the loser always💜
checkpoints.text: The only game where losing to you still feels like winning.

checkpoints.question: One more song 🎶
checkpoints.hint: This one is from me to you.
checkpoints.reveal: Placeholder – write why this song is yours.

checkpoints.title: Good night, aşkım
checkpoints.text: 4 hours apart, you always fall asleep first, and I always stay up a little longer just to say it back.

finale.line: 9,571 km. 4 hours apart. And every single message still found its way to you.
letter: One year ago you came looking for me, and I've been here ever since.
We have never been in the same room, but you are still the first person I want to tell everything to. The good things, the stupid things, the 3 AM things.
Thank you for every good morning, every 'salak', every 'dkdldk', and every time you stayed up even when you were sleepy.
I love you, aşkım. Today, and every night under the same moon.
